Q: How is pricing calculated?\nA: Power Washer: $55.99/day | Tiller: $68.99/day
Q: What is the rental limit?\nA: Maximum 7 days per rental
Q: Any additional policies?\nA: Tools must be returned clean and in good working condition. Late returns may include additional fees.
Power Washer costs $55.99 per day and Tiller costs $68.99 per day. The total is calculated by multiplying the daily rate by the number of rental days.
What is the maximum rental period?
The maximum rental period is 7 days per rental. This limit helps ensure equipment availability for other customers.
Tools must be returned in good working condition. A security deposit may be required. Late returns may incur additional fees. Please inspect tools upon pickup and report any damage immediately.
Choose a Power Washer for outdoor cleaning tasks like decks and driveways. Choose a Tiller for garden preparation and soil cultivation. Both tools come with basic safety instructions.
